cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Sign here to say you support the extension. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

mechanism: A organizes an extension proposal while negotiating a minimally exposing but identifiable sign of B support to protect it from objections.
confusable: Unlike anonymous encouragement, the endorsement must be visibly traceable; confident authority depends on accommodating B reluctance without losing that traceability.
comparison: Initials and a named key differ from spoken versus emailed rota support.
seedUse: Use D52-b extension/name/initials/key with S02-a treating an adapted endorsement as the chosen process.
